subject: Module API docs formatting and improve script (#2950)
reason: The change edits only comments in src/module.c (a function-name typo and comment line wrapping in a doc example) and the offline Ruby documentation-generation script utils/generate-module-api-doc.rb. No executable server code, command behaviour, reply format, replication, persistence, or module API semantics change, so there is nothing a fuzzer scenario could reach or regress.
